notes.title: Monster Chef Demo Patch 2 Notes
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075091/182bf663180cadb2a671c6d0e677d337bcea2421.png"][/img][/p][h1]Ciao to all Chef Warriors and Innkeepers![/h1][p]
Here’s our second demo patch, focused on improving gameplay flow and squashing nasty bugs. Those daring enough to return to the Fresche Frasche Woods will be greeted by snappier combat and some beautiful graphics!!

[/p][h2]Below you’ll find the full list of changes:[/h2][p]

Added updated graphics for the Fugo habitat in the Wilds, now featuring gigantic mushrooms.
 	 	
Added a dynamic minimap in the Inn, displaying Pranzo's position and responding to Room's unlocks.
 	
Added some time to the Inn's minigame, allowing the player to serve a greater number of plates.
	
Added a tutorial card to clarify Dusk and Nightfall behaviour.
	
Improved signaling for the Motato healing bushes.
 	
Improved transparency for the trees in the Wilds, grating the player better vision.
 	
Improved timing for the Salthasker's recharge animation.

Improved feedback when the Monsters become cookable. 	

Improved various SFX and music.

NPC's Daily Menus are no longer forced as Active Menu. 	

The Saltshaker attack can now be cancelled from mid animation, quickening the combat's pace.
 	
Fixed a bug where the Blacksmith's Menu won't spawn Psycabbages if you haven't completed the Carpenter's Menu.

Fixed a bug where the Chef Sense’s trail led the player to dead ends.

Fixed resolution change problems for 2K screens.
 	
Various other fixes and small changes.

 	
We are deeply grateful for all the feedback we have received so far: every opinion is fundamental to improve the game. Although some additional planned changes aren't ready at the moment, we are working hard on all suggestions to serve you the best version of Monster Chef we can cook.
[i]
NOTE: The demo version is now 0.0.14. All previous save files are unfortunately obsolete, so you’ll need to start the demo from the beginning. We know it can be a bit of a pain, but think of it as the perfect excuse to discover all the new improvements, we promise it’ll be worth it! As always, we’re eager to hear your feedback.[/i]

Buon Appetito!
Studio Pizza 🍕[/p]

notes.title: Important Notice – Some antivirus software blocks the demo launch
notes.content: [h1]Hello Warrior Chefs and  Innkeepers,[/h1][p] We’ve found that some antivirus software may completely block the launch of the Monster Chef Demo, even though it installs fine on Steam.  [/p][list][*][p]We confirm that the demo is safe and free of threats.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The executable has been checked and approved by Steam, which verifies all content uploaded to the platform.  [/p][/*][/list][p]This issue happens because some antivirus software is overly cautious with executables generated using Unity, the development engine we use for Monster Chef. [/p][p]Even though the file is safe, antivirus software may block it preemptively without any malicious code inside.  [/p][h3]What to do if the demo won't start [/h3][list][*][p]Check if your antivirus has quarantined or blocked a game file.  [/p][/*][*][p]Add the demo folder to your antivirus exceptions or exclusions.  [/p][/*][*][p]Restart Steam and try launching the demo again.  [/p][/*][/list][p]We’re working to reduce these issues in future updates. [/p][p]Thank you for your understanding and support. If you have any questions or problems, write to us in the comments or on our Discord! [/p][p]Studio Pizza 🍕[/p]

notes.title: Monster Chef – Demo now available!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Welcome to Monster Chef.[/b][/h3][p]You’re not just a warrior, you’re a chef!
Fight your enemies, season them mid-fight, and serve delicious meals to your guests.[/p][p][b]Slice it. Salt it. Serve it.[/b][/p][p]Play it on our Monster Chef Demo Steam Page [url="https://s.team/a/3721600"]s.team/a/3721600[/url][/p][p]In this exclusive demo, you’ll play as [b]Pranzo[/b], a fearless chef-warrior who doesn’t just hunt monsters — he cooks them on the spot using his trusty [b]Chef Weapons[/b]. [/p][p][b]What’s on the menu:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Explore the Fresche Frasche Woods[/b]: a procedurally generated biome teeming with adorable yet ferocious monsters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle Modoro[/b]: earn 30 Reputation Points in your Inn and face a giant, furious tomato-boss.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cook in real time[/b]: defeat enemies and execute recipes mid-fight![/p][/*][*][p][b]Manage your Inn[/b]: fix it up, serve your dishes, and start building your outstanding inn.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Saving[/b] is enabled.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Languages fully supported in the demo:[/b]
EN, IT, FR, DE, ES, ZH-CN, JA, KO, RU, PL, PT-BR, PT-PT[/p][/*][/list][quote][p]Please note: This is a demo version. Some features (like additional biomes, bosses, recipes, and advanced upgrades) will be available in the full game.[/p][/quote][h3]A message from Studio Pizza[/h3][p]We’re a small team of 8 developers from Italy who decided to believe in this project and shape this unique adventure about monsters and good food. [b]Monster Chef[/b] is a fully independent game, made without the support of a publisher. We’ve faced countless challenges, but never stopped cooking up this fantasy world. [/p][p]This demo is just the beginning, and we’re incredibly grateful to everyone who gives it a try, adds it to their Wishlist, or shares it with a friend.[/p][p]Your support means the world to us, [b]thank you for believing in us.[/b][/p][p]If you enjoyed the demo we’d love to have you in our growing community! Join our Discord and become part of the guild of [b]Chef Warriors[/b] and [b]Innkeepers[/b] — share your thoughts, meet other players and cook up ideas together with us.[/p][p][b]→ [/b][url="https://discord.com/invite/UxqH638pV3"]https://discord.com/invite/UxqH638pV3[/url] [b]←[/b][/p][p]We can’t wait to hear what you think![/p][p]— [i]The Studio Pizza team[/i] 🍕[/p]
